name: base1-openjev-group-retreat
scope: Prepared close primary and southwest flank on original base1 BSP/AAS. Original monsters removed; native vulnerable infantry, barrels and items remain. Enemy startup movement is allowed; no forced model answer, invulnerability or post-start actor repositioning.
maneuver_acceptance: Live model retreat and at least two actual firing retreat steps with two confirmed lines of sight
At least two observed steps increase distance to the current spacing target by over two units, measured against its same-frame origin
No observed retreat step approaches any observed threat by over four units; planned-path approach limit stays two units
Native projectile spawn matched to group retreat command frame and spawncount, then monster health damage linked by shot ID
No death, map transition or teammate; one initial teleport/spawn/health fixture only; distinct acknowledged seeds, 2x and valid source fingerprint
full_fight_acceptance: All maneuver gates and both native infantry kills. An accepted maneuver alone does not accept the complete suite.
